manifest.description: Diagnose unsafe Rust boundaries that hide architectural contracts or caller obligations without a reviewable invariant.
when_to_use: callers depend on an undocumented invariant at an unsafe boundary
unsafe code hides ownership, lifecycle, or public API obligations
a correction plan needs tests, docs, adapters, or safer abstractions around the boundary
anti_patterns: do not use for unsafe block inventory alone
do not use for clippy missing-safety-doc without an architectural contract claim
do not imply a mutating safety-boundary atom exists
